tei:div.tei:p: "$ (81)༄༅// dpal tog tse ba'i bsam mi khyab kyi gdams ngag bzhugs so/// /

(82)༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ a tsant+ya kra mo pa de sha nā maḥ bod skad du/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rim pa'i man ngag ces bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// shes rab rang bzhin bsam mi khyab/ stong nyid ngo bo nyid zung 'jug gnyis med stong pa nyid/ snying po'i rtser byung ba// bsam yas thabs bsam mi khyab gsum ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ gnyis med mkha' bdag la// phyag 'tshal de ni chos thams cad kyi babs sam rtogs pa'i phyag ste/ rang gi rig pa'i ye shes ni/ legs mthong gang yin 'dir phyag yin/ bzang po'i zhal snga yi// yang dag yang dag spong ba rim 'od bri rgyu rgyud bar bya/ rgyu rgyud thabs dang po rten gsungs dang shes rab gsang chen po// snying rje bsam yas mtshan nyid ni// ngag gi lam 'das spyod yul gyi// ye shes ngang gis skye bar 'gyur// de ni dngos po'i gzugs kyis ni// dang po rten gsungs/ dmigs shes dmigs pa bsgom pa min// bde ba'i rnam pa'i rang bzhin gyis// rang byung gnyis su med pa'i mchog /byang sems rdo rje can bcas pas// dngos po med pas gzigs mi 'gyur// rtag dang mi rtag dbye ba yis// don dam gnyis su gzigs mi 'gyur// dngos po rnams kyi rang bzhin 'di// dmigs pa med cing stong pa med// (83)gnyis po dag gi spyod pa yis// gnyis med ye shes 'bar bar 'gyur// thams cad gnyis med rnam pa ste// gnyis po de dag yod ma yin// mnyam par ro gcig rnam pa ste// bsam gyis mi khyab ye shes mchog /rtog pa rtog pa'i rnal 'byor gyis// gnyis med mchog ni bsgom pa min// bde ba'i rdo rje mi rtog pa// bsam mi khyab kyis thob par 'gyur// bskyed pa rnam par rtog pa'i rgyu// rdzogs pa gnyis kyang de bzhin no// gnyis kyi rnam par bral ba ste// bag chags bag chags ldan pa spangs// bzang po'i zhal snga rim 'ongs pa// ye shes bag chags rnam bral ba// rang byung rlom sems med pa ni// rtog pa thams cad yang dag spangs// dngos dang dngos med rang bzhin gyi// bag chags nyid ni 'ching ba nyid// mi rtog pa yi rang bzhin gyis// bsam mi khyab kyis gcod par 'gyur// rtog pa'i dri ma'i drwa ba yis// rin chen sems ni dri can byas// dri ma bral bas sangs rgyas nyid// gnyis su med pa'i ye shes brjod// thams cad rtog med bdag nyid du// rnal 'byor pa yis rtag tu blta// ting 'dzin bsgom pa 'di nyid ni// bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyis bstan// gang gi rang bzhin ma skyes pa// 'gags (84)pa nyid ni yod mi 'gyur// de yi ye shes gnyis med cing*// rnam rtog thams cad yang dag spangs// sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin sogs kyis// rtog pa phyi rol nyid du bshad// bde chen rdo rje can dpal gyis// mi rtog don ni skyes pa po// phyi rol nang gi rnam rtog gis// 'jig rten thams cad yang dag gnas// gnyis med gnyis las rnam grol ba// ye shes ngang gis skye bar 'gyur// dngos po med pa bsgom pa min// dngos por yang ni bsgom pa min// sems dpa'i bde ba mtha' med pa// bsam gyis mi khyab gnyis med gnas// sems can kun la gang bsam pa// shes rab snying po rnam par gnas// snying rje padma'i mda' las ni// mtshon cha'i 'ben nam bde chen po// brtan dang g.yo ba'i dngos po rnams// gnyis su med pas rnam par gnas// de rnams rang bzhin rnam par dag

/zhi ba nam mkha' dri ma med// gnyis su med pa ming tsam ste// de yang ming ni yong mi 'gyur// tshor dang ma tshor mtshon bya bral// gnyis med bde ba chen po nyid// rtag pa kun las rnam par grol// gnyis gnyis med cing mchog zhi ba// mkha' mnyam rnam rtog las grol ba// de ni gnyis su med par brjod// bsam yas gnas kyi rnal 'byor gyis// dngos po thams cad rnam par bsgoms// chos kyi zhal snga'i rim 'ongs pa// bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyis gsungs// gnyis med rnam pa'i dbye ba yis// bde chen mgon po dpal gyis ni// gcig tu gyur pa'i rang bzhin gyis// 'gro ba rnams kyis rnam par sprul// stong pa dmigs par smra ba yis// rdzun du smras pas bslus pa rnams// rtog pa rmongs pa'i 'ching ba yis// (85)bde ba dam pa nyid mi rtogs// thabs dang shes rab rnam dag pa// ngan rtags rtogs pas phyi rol nyid// gnyis med ye shes rnal 'byor che// bde ba chen po gcig pu nyid// gang zhig bsam yas rang bzhin phyir// sangs rgyas blo yi spyod yul min// de yi rang bzhin thams cad nyid// rang byung bsam pa rnams las 'das// sa steng srog chags thams cad rnams// rtog pa'i dra bas nyams par 'gyur// gnyis med ye shes gcig pu de// rnam par rtog pa thams cad spangs// ji snyed rgyun dang rgyun bcas pa// cha gnyis yod pa mi 'gyur zhing*// dbu mar yang ni mi dmigs pa// gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mchog /kun rdzob thams cad tha dad pa// gnyis dang gnyis med rnam rtog nyid// thabs dang shes rab rnal 'byor che// ro gcig gnyis su med par brjod// 'dod chags 'dod chags bral ba pa// dbu mar dmig pa mi 'gyur ro// bde ba yang dag rig pa med// de ni gnyis su med par brjod// mtshan gzhi mtshan nyid rnam par grol// rig pa po dang rig bya spangs// bdag med so so spangs pa yis// rin chen sems ni rab rtogs bya// dngos po'i rang bzhin med pa'i phyir// gnyis med nyid kyang mthong mi 'gyur// mig gi rnam shes rtogs pa yis// gnyis med ye shes ngo mtshar che// spros pa thams cad rnam bral zhing*// nam mkha' lta bu dri ma med// rtog pa'i drwa ba rnam bcad cing*// bsam gyis mi khyab gnyis med mchog

/gnyis med bcud kyis phigs pa yis// rdo shing lji ba'i 'gyur ba rnams// lha yi rnam par 'gyur bar ni// bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyis bstan// thabs dang shes rab snying rje che// gcig tu (86)ro gcig rnam par nyid// der ni ye shes rdzogs par 'gyur// gnyis med bde ba chen po nyid// gzugs dang sgra dang ro las 'das// dri dang reg bya la sogs spangs// chos dbyings 'gyur ba rnam par dag /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mchog /rtog pa kun las rnam par grol// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs// rang bzhin rnam dag ma gos pa// gnyis med don ni dam pa la// ma skyes pa dang ma 'gags pa// mi 'gyur ba dang mi gnas pa// mngon par ye shes gnyis med mchog /'di ni phyag rgya chen po nyid// yon tan rnams dang skyon rnams nyid// rnam pa sems su brjod pa bya// des na rtse gcig ye shes mchog /rlom sems med pa'i rang bzhin las// ye shes ngang gi skye 'gyur te// cung zad kyang ni bsgom pa med// gang phyir bsam yas chos 'di ni// sangs rgyas rnams kyi gnyis med gnas// shin tu dri med ches dag cing*// sgom pa po dang bsgom bya yang*// dpal ldan bde ba'i 'byung gnas kun// rnam rtog med pas nges mthong 'gyur// lha yi gzugs ni du ma dang*// rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs sku// sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan thams cad dang*// rnal 'byor ma yi dkyil 'khor tshogs// khro bo rgyal po thams cad dang*// de bzhin rig ma lha mo nyid// dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bzang po dang*// snang ba'i rnam pa dri med dang*// de bzhin mdo sde'i sde snod dang*// gzhan yang pha rol phyin rim dang*// sngags dang phyag rgya rig pa dang*// de bzhin snying nyid bsgrub pa dang*// sngags kyi smra ba ma lus pa// dkyil 'khor dang ni sbyin sreg las// bzlas dang mchod pa'i cho ga rnams/ phyi nang gi /gnyis med las ni ngang gi (87)skye// gzhu ni zhi ba nyi ma sa// de bzhin mchod 'os khyab 'jug pa// rig byed tshad mar smra ba dang*// gzhan yang rang gis skye bar 'gyur// kun bden gnas kyi sbyor ba 'di// bsam gyis mi khyab mi rtog pa// kun tu bzang po zhes bya lha// gnyis med yid bzhin nor bu bzhin// rkang 'og ral gri dril bu dang*// shing lham bum pa gnod sbyin mo// bcud dang mig sman bzang po yang*// rang gis grub ste gzhan yod min// sngags pas dngos po bsgom mi bya// dngos med nyid kyang bsgom pa min// rtog pa med pa'i thar pa min// thams cad rang gis skye bar 'gyur// sangs rgyas nyid kyang 'grub 'gyur na// zhi ba khyab 'jug sogs ci smos// de yi mtshan nyid yod ma yin// gzugs dang mtshan nyid kha dog med// sgyu ma'i rnam 'dzin bzang po nyid// dwangs pa'i rang bzhin dri ma med// rang bzhin 'od gsal rnam pa ste// rtag tu bde ba'i 'byung gnas dga'// sku dang gsung dang thugs dang bral// me long 'bar ba'i phung po nyid// mchog dga' bde ba'i rnam pa ste// rtag tu bde chen 'byung ba po// bstan pa'i tshig gi sbyor ba yis// ming dang kha dog rab tu brjod// gzhan tu ngag gi lam 'das phyir// sla ba nyid du mi nus so// bya bar 'dod pa'i tshul gyis ni// 'dod pa'i don gyi sla bas kyang*// gsang ba'i mchod pa'i dus su ni// shes rab gnyis med 'gyur bas so// gcig pu'i rnam par rang bzhin las// bag chags zad par 'gyur bas na// sangs rgyas nyid ni ngas thob par// bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyis bstan// kha dog tha dad bye brag gis// gzhung ni tha dad sbyor ba las// bag chags (88)dri mas dbang bskur bas// gnyis med nyid ni yod ma yin// thog ma dbus deng tha ma bral// bskyed pa dang ni rdzogs pa spangs/

grol ba sems rang sems dpa' ni// gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mchog /sangs rgyas gnyis med ces bya bar// bzang po'i zhal snga nas gyis gsungs// de phyir sangs rgyas rtogs pa las// sgrub po dam pa sangs rgyas 'gyur// bstan pa'i tshig gi sbyor bas ni// sangs rgyas gnyis su med par btags// don dam tha dad med tshul gyis// sangs rgyas med cing gnyis med med// ye shes mchog tu gyur pas na// rtag pa'i dri ma ring bar 'gyur// dngos po la sogs rtog pa kun// gnam gyis brkos na rgog tu 'gyur// bzang po'i zhal snga'i bka' drin gyis// nyams pa goms pa'i sbyor ba las// gnyis med zhes bya bzung ba ni// bdag la rnal 'byor pas bzod mdzod// mkhas pas rab tu 'bad pas kyang*// bag chags rnams ni zad par bya// gzhan tu bskal pa grangs med par// sangs rgyas nyid ni yod ma yin// ye shes gnyis med mgon nas ni// bag chags rnams ni zad par byed// bag chags zad par 'gyur ba na// gnyis su med pa sangs rgyas brjod// bag chags bral ba'i gnas skabs na// skyes bu tha ma 'bring po dang*// gang la phyogs ni yod min pa// de la sangs rgyas brjod par bya// rang bzhin med pa'i rang bzhin gyis// shes rab char yang yang dag gnas// thabs ni dngos po bskyed pa bor// bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyis bstan// de dag 'dus pa'i bdag nyid can// ro gcig pa yi sbyor ba las// bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyis gsungs// 'di ni gnyis su med pa mchog /gdams (89)dang bsgom pa bsam la med// mchog tu dga' ba'i gzugs can ma// sangs rgyas nyid ni thob pa'i phyir// bzang pos bzang po gsung pa nyid// dpe ni chos rnams thams cad la// bzhag pa nyid du de mi nus// mig sogs yid kyi rnam shes kyis// dpe yi dngos po rnam par spangs// gcig nyid thogs pa med pa ste// mtha' med rnam pas yang dag gnas// bla ma'i zhal snga'i bka' drin las// mchog gcig gis ni shes par 'gyur// rnal 'byor skyes bur bshad pa ste// rjes su rnal 'byor kun rdzob nyid// gnyis med ye shes rnal 'byor che// rnal 'byor pa nyid sangs rgyas 'gyur// nyi zla gza' yis zin pa na// shes rab rdo rje sbyor ba las// zhu ba gnyis med ye shes las// skye ba 'dir ni sangs rgyas nyid// don dam dga' ba'i rang bzhin te// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs// grub pa'i gzugs su the tshom med// snying rje gnyis su med pa mchog

/gzugs mchog tha ma 'bring po gang*// gang yang mig gis mthong gyur pa// don dam don gyi rang bzhin gyis// gnyis med dam pa blta bar bya// sgra dang sgra ngan rna cha las// gang yang rna bas thos gyur pa// sgra las 'das pa'i ye shes mchog /rna ba gnyis su med pa mchog /ro mchog ro ni ngan pa dang*// gang yang lce yis myang 'gyur ba// ro drug dngos po du ma yis// gnyis med mchog ni rtog par bya// ri dwags chang la sogs pa'i dris// sna yis dri ni snom shes pa// gcig tu gyur pa'i rang bzhin gyis// gnyis med mchog ni shes par bya// grim pa'i rnam pa'i rang bzhin gyis// skye gnas cha las skyes pa yis// thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba yi// rdzogs pa gnyis su med pa mchog /mkha' med thams (90)cad khyab pa po// ye shes snang ba'i 'od zer las// rang dbang mchog tu dga' ba nyid// gnyis med sangs rgyas dam pa bde// 'du byed tshor ba 'du shes dang*// gzugs dang rnam par shes pa nyid// ye shes lnga yi yan lag sku// mnga' bdag gnyis su gnyis su med// rtag pa mi bskyod rin chen dang*// tshe dang de bzhin don yod nyid// lnga bdag 'gyur ba'i ril po ni// drug pa bde ba chen po nyid// sa dang chu dang de bzhin me// rlung dang yang ni nam mkha' nyid// 'byung lnga lhan cig skyes pa ni// byang chub gnyis su med par 'gyur// me long mnyam nyid bya nan tan// so sor rtogs pa'i chos dbyings kyis// rnam par rtog pa rtogs pa'i tshul// yid mes gcig pu gnyis su med// gzhung la sogs pa bskal pa yis// sems can bsam pa'i dbang gis ni// zhi sogs khyab mjug tshangs pa dang*// kun mkhyen gcig pu gnyis su med// dmigs sogs ma tshang med pa dang*// yid las 'das pa'i spyod yul lo// don dam gnyis su med pa'i ming*// ngag gi spros pa kun rdzob nyid// don dam gnas skabs byed brag las// sangs rgyas med cing gnyis med de// rtog pa nam mkha' sbyor bas ni// ngag gi spros pa'ang smra bar bya// bstan bcos rim pa'i tshig gis ni// rnam pa'i cha las bshad par bya// gzhan tu sangs rgyas gnyis med par// smra ba nyid du mi nus su// stong pa bcu drug bshad pa dang*// shes rab bcur ni rtag pa dang*// sangs rgyas lngar yang bshad pa dang*// kun rdzob brgyad ni gnyis su med// me long snang ba'i gzugs brnyan la// ji ltar thams cad mthong gyur pa// de bzhin gnyis med ye (91)shes 'dir// sangs rgyas byang chub bsam mi khyab// khams gsum dag ni thams cad du// skye dang gnas pa'i rgyu rnams kyis// de kun gnyis med ye shes las// skye bo thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur// rgya mtsho ri dang shing dang ni// rtsa lcugs 'khril shing la sogs pa// gnyis med ye shes de 'byung ba// 'di la the tshom yod ma yin// ma dad pa dang gcig pa ru// 'di gnyis yod pa ma yin no// gnyis med ye shes mngon pa las// gzhan yang thams cad skye par 'gyur// 'di ni thabs kyi sbyor bas ni// shes rab gnyis med rang bzhin las// skye ba 'dir ni rnal 'byor pas// sangs rgyas nyid ni 'phral tu rnyed// ye shes dag gi rang bzhin mchog

/bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa'i gzhung*// zhal nas snyan tu zhal nas snyan// bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyis gsungs// 'dis ni rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyis// bzang po'i zhal snga bka' drin las// sgom pa bsam yas rnal 'byor gyis// sangs rgyas nyid ni nges par nos// rta mchog bī ṇa'i zhal snga dang*// ind+ra bhū ti legs smin bcas// sgeg pa'i rdo rje ghun de ri// slob dpon padma snying rje che// chos kyi zhal snga'i rim pa la// bzang po'i zhal snga 'phrad pa ni// thams cad kyi ni dgongs pa gcig /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mchog /sngags kyi smra ba ma lus dang*// de bzhin pha rol phyin pa'i lung*// mdo sde'i sde snod la sogs las// 'dir gcig gnyis med bde chen po// mchod 'os nyi ma zhi ba sogs// so ma grub pa'i mtha' nyid dang*// khyab 'jug dang ni shed bu'i chos// gnyis su med pas bstan pa'o// gnyis med phyi rol yod (92)ma yin// lha dang lha min tha ma mi// thams cad gnyis med ye shes te// so sor gsal ba mthong bar 'gyur// gnyis med dang ni snying rje 'dras// thab dang shes rab mnyam par ldan// stong pa'i bye brag tha dad pa// sangs rgyas yan lag kun gyi bla// 'di ni bzang po'i zhal snga'i gzhung*// ye shes rgya mtsho dam pa nyid// 'o ma bzhin bsrubs rnam par ni// gzhan yang thams cad rang skye 'gyur// tshangs pa khyab 'jug dbang phyug dang*// gang yang sangs rgyas sogs grags dang*// nyi zla skar mar bcas pa yang*// ye shes rgya mtsho las 'byung zhing*// legs smin dang ni dbyangs can nyid// bdud rtsi rnams kyi ro mchog nyid// lhar bcas lha min mi rnams ni// bdud rtsi las ni thams cad langs// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa'i dge ba// bcu gsum du yang rnam bshad pa// gru gsum rnam par 'byung ba ni// 'di ni chos kyi 'byung gnas brjod// nyi zla chu yis gang ba yis// shes rab gzugs ni cher 'bar ba'i// bde las bde ba chen po kun// sangs rgyas nyid ni thob pa'i phyir// pad chen 'dab ma bye ba nyid// de la nang du rnam par gnas// mchog dang mchog min zer ba ni// ā li kā li yang dag ldan// zla ba nyi ma gos kyis bkang*// shes rab dgu dang mnyam par ldan// 'jag cing 'bar ba'i rnam pa nyid// zla ba'i thig le 'byung gnas mchog

/dga' ba bskyed do bzang mo nyid// ma lus don gyi 'bras 'byin ma// dang po'i bdud rtsi shin tu gang*// nor bu rin chen mnyam par ldan// yon tan mtha' yas sa yi gnas// bde dpal rdo rje can gyi gnas// thams cad bde ba byad pa can// phung dang bskyed pa byed pa can// lha yi gzugs ni du ma dang*// gnyis med rgya (93)mtsho las byung ba// chos dang longs spyod rdzogs gzugs dang*// sprul pa yi ni sku nyid dang*// sems can du ma kun gyi don// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams rnams kyi// mtha' las mthar thug thams cad du// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba bo// ye shes bcu yi stobs dang ldan// shes rab gtso mo dam pa nyid// padma'i mkha' 'gro byol song lam// nges pa bzang po'i rim 'ong pa'o// snying padma lte ba'i padma dang*// de bzhin lkog ma'i padma nyid// dril can skye gnas padma yang*// byol song sgo ru rnam par gnas// gshang gci khu ba 'pho ba ni// sgo dgu dag tu srad pa na// lha dang bsgom dang nyan pa dang*// ro mchog rnams ni rag par 'gyur// padma'i sku mnyam rnam pa nyid// 'og dang steng du rnam par gnas// 'di ni shes rab zhes bshad pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi yum nyid do// de la dbus su gnas pa'i lha// dam pa'i dbang phyug gnyis med pa// padma gsum du rol par 'gyur// thams cad mkhyen pa bde chen po// me dang chu dang dbang chen dang*// rlung gis rnam par brgyan pa nyid// dal bar rgyu ba'i rig ma yis// bye brag gsum du khyer bar 'gyur// dril can zla ba'i lam gyis ni// sna yi rdog ma'i sbyor ba las// tsa na rdo rje'i spu gu ru// sangs rgyas phreng ba gnyis su med// spyod pas yongs su nyon mongs na// dril can rtse mor ngal sos nas// rdo rje lce yi rab sbyor bas// bdud rtsi btung bar bya ba nyid// de nas lus ni rnam dag pa// rang bzhin dri ma med par 'gyur// shes rab bzang zhing blo dang ldan// rga dang 'chi ba mnyam dar byas// bzang po'i zhal sngas rnal 'byor 'di// bdag la dka' ba med par gsungs// ting 'dzin bdud (94)rtsi zhes bya ba// bden zhing bden don gzhan du min// sna yis rngub pa'i bye brag gis// haṃ gis rnam pa ma bcos pa// dril can spu gu'i lam gyis ni// lam nas khyer zhing nges pa'i gnas// de la sgo ru ngal sos shing*// dag pa'i rnam pa 'od gsal ba// thog med gnyis med ces bya ba// bde dpal rnam par yang dag gnas// de nas rlung gis phul ba dang*// dbang chen yang ni 'dor bar 'gyur// mchog gi dbang phyug ma bcos pa// sa ni bcu gsum thob pa dang*// bde ba'i dbang phyug lta bur bzhag

/thog ma med par 'grub pa'i gzungs// chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba po// bzang po'i zhal snga'i rim pa ni// nyung ngu'i rim pa snying po'i don// gang yang thos pa kun bzung nas// de thos bsam pa sgom pa nyid// bzang po'i zhal snga'i bka' drin gyis// nyan pa goms pa'i sbyor ba las// dge can tog rtse zhes bya ba// des ni 'di ni yang dag 'du// bdag ni bzang po'i zhal snga dang*// slob dpon gzhan dang rnal 'byor pa// sems can rnams ni ma lus pa'i// bran du skye dang skye gyur cig /'dis ni bsam pa'i sgo nas ni// gal te bdag ni sangs rgyas 'gyur// ma gyur na'ang dmyal bar 'gro// dmyal ba nyid ni bde ba can// bla ma'i rim pa dri med mtha' yas rnal 'byor ni// blo chen ma lus sngags kyi rang bzhin gzhung gyur pa// bsam gyis mi khyab gnyis med cha ni rdzogs rim nyid// rnal 'byor gzhung lugs snying po'i bdag blo rmongs pas na// blo chung bdag nyid dran pa'i don du bris pa yin// bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba phyag rgya chen po grub pa dpal tog rtse ba'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// rgya gar gyi mkhan po ratna badzra dang*/ dge slong shākya ye (95)shes kyis bsgyur ba'o// maṅga lam/ ༈ slob dpon tog rtse pa'i lam bsam gyis mi khyab pa lnga'i lo rgyus bzhugs so// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang gis sprul pa'i sku ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mar bstan nas/ slob dpon rta ma1chog la dbang bskur zhing bsam mi khyab lnga yis gdams te/ slob dpon u rgyan gyi gnas su sku 'khrungs// dur khrod kyi gnas su gnas pa'i tshe/ u rgyan gyi rgyal po rin po che ind+ra bhū ti ces pa'i 'khor rnams kyis/ yang nas yang du 'tshe ba byas pa las// yul thams cad rtas gang bar byas te// 'bras kyi zhing thams cad med par byas pas mthar sprul pa bsdus te/

de nyid kyis rgyal po btul nas rdo rje theg pa la bkod do// des dbang bskur zhing gdams ngag gnang ba ni// slob dpon chen po bī ṇi pa 2zhes bya ba yin te// tha mal pa'i rigs me tog 'tshong pa grub pa brnyes pas spyod lam tambu ra'i rtsed mos 'da' bas ta mbu ra'i zhabs zhes pa yin no// de dus rgyal po ngo mtshar skyes nas btul te/ des dbang bskur zhing gdams ngag gnang ba ni rgyal po ind+ra bhū 3ti yin te/ mchog dbang rin po che thob pa'i de nyid du dbang gdams ngag cig car rdzogs pa mtshan gcig gis phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pas/ rgyal khams gcig gi grong pa rnams mkha' spyod du 'gro nus pa'o// des dbang bskur zhing gdams ngag gnang ba ni/ legs smin bya ba dpal mo chung ngu yin te/ des yang dag pa'i don yid la byas pa las/ lus de nyid kyis drod rtags rnams mngon tu byas nas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub mngon tu (96)'gyur ba yin pas/ 'gro ba gzhan gyi don tu 'gyur na 'khor lo spro zhing bsdu ba la sogs pa mang du byed nus pa'o// des dbang bskur zhing gdams ngag gnang ba slob dpon sgeg pa5'i rdo rje yin te/ drod kyi ye shes la dbang thob pas rgyan drug dang ldan pa phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i spyod pa mdzad pa shar phyogs su sku 'khrungs pa de nyid kyis mchog gi dngos grub thob bo// des dbang bskur zhing gdams ngag gnang ba ni/ slob dpon 6gundhi ri bya ba yin te/ nub phyogs u rgyan gyi yul gyi dgon pa cig la gnas pa'i tshe/ zas kyi bya ba thams cad bye'u gundhi ri zhes bya ba'i tshod ma dpag tu med pa byas te tshims pa dang*/ kha nas spur gtong ba dang*/ de 'dra ba'i bsad gsol sogs pa tshar bcad pa dang*/ rjes su bzung gis 'gro ba mang po 'dul ba'o// de'i slob ma ni slob dpon chen po padma 7badzra chung ba yin par bzhed do// phyag dang zhabs la padma'i ri mo gsal bar yod pa yungs 'bru gcig gi nang du stong gsum tshud pa la che chung med pa/

chu bo gyen la bzlog cing rtsigs pa dang ri la thogs pa med pa/ khyad par du snying rje chen pos dud 'gro gdug pa can la sogs pa 'chings nus pa/ phyag rgya padma can la brten nas lus de nyid kyis mchog grub bo// des dbang bskur gdams ngag gnang ba ni// slob dpon chen po dpal ldan chos kyi sde yin te/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes pa nyid kyis spang bya 'jig rten chos brgyad spong nus pa dang*/ bya ba gang gis kyang gdul bya'i bsam pa tshim nus pa dang*/ lus de nyid kyis phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob bo// des dbang bskur zhing gdams ngag gnang ba ni/ dpal ldan bzang po'i zhabs yin te// ind+ra bhu ti chung ba dang*/ nus pa (97)'gran pa'i tshe zhal bye ba la sogs par sprul nas rgyal po pham par byas pa dang*/ rgyal po'i gzugs dang longs spyod kyi nga rgyal rnams med par nus pa'o// des dbang bskur zhing gdams ngag gnang ba ni// dpal ldan tog rtse zhabs yin te/ rigs ngan so nam pa'i rigs yin pa la/ rgyal po'i skyed mo'i tshal dang ldum ra la sogs pa'i bya ba byed pa la yid gzhung pa dang*/ dbang dang gdams ngag gi dus nyid na'ang rtogs pa mchog tu gyur pa ste/ sde snod gsum gyis bsdus pa'i sgra don thams cad la thogs pa med cing ma rmongs par gyur pa dang*/ phyi'i rig byed bzhi la sogs pa dang*/ nang rgyud sde bzhi la sogs pa la sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i shes rab can// rang gi bla ma'i gsungs gcig gis 'khor 'das dbyer med du rtogs par nus pa dang*/ lhag mthong gi ting nge 'dzin du ma la brten nas bdag gi rtogs pa yi ger bkod pa yin no// de ltar dam pa dgu dgongs rgyud gcig pa'i dbang du byas nas/ gtam rgyud ci rigs par brjod pa tsam mo// slob dpon tog rtse zhabs kyi rjes la shing lo pa ni/ gdan du shing gi 'dab ma bting zhing shing lo'i na bza' gsol bas so// de'i rjes karkha pa ni/

karkha pa zhes bya ba snyan shal ring bas so// de'i rjes la dpa' bo rdo rje ni rten rab tu byung ba'o/ ḍā ki mas phyag nas gtor ma len pa dang*/ grom pa rgyang du byon nas/ dgun grang tsam na lho ba la du par gshegs skad/ de'i rjes la bod kyi slob dpon ni/ spang mkhar mu gu lud pa/

'brog mi lo tsā ba ye shes/ mkhar chung ba: kun rig / dgon pa ba chos 'bang / des bla ma sa skya pa kun dga' snying po la gdams pa'o// lo rgyus (98)bstan zin to/ ༈ slob dpon tog rtse pas mdzad pa'i bsam mi khyab kyi gdams pa gsal bar byed pa bzhugs so/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// rta mchog la sogs pa brgyud pa dgu pa'i rta mchog bī ṇa'i zhal snga dang*/ ind+ra bhū ti legs smin bcas// sgeg pa'i rdo rje gundhe ri// slob dpon padma snying rje che// chos kyi zhal snga'i rim pa la// bzang po'i zhal snga 'phrad pa dang*// thams cad kyang ni dgongs pa gcig /zhes gzhung nas 'byung so mthar/ tog rtse pa/ bhū ṣa ṇa/ dha ma pa/ karkha pa/ dge slong dpa' bo rdo rje'i bar du brgyud pa ma chang pa'i lugs kyis/ rgyu dus su lta ba gtan la dbab pa/ lam dus su ting nge 'dzin skyed cing sbyang ba/ 'bras bu'i dus su ye shes mngon tu 'gyur ba ste gsum gyis lam dang 'bras bu thams cad bsdus par bzhed do// de la dang po rgyu dus su lta ba gtan la dbab pa la/ rab tu phyin pa'i theg pa ltar na/ gtan la dbab par bya ba phung po khams dang skye mched la sogs pa yin pa la/ 'di la gtan la dbab par bya ba lus ngag yid gsum yin pas da 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal kyang lus ngag yid gsum la myong la/ lam du ting nge 'dzin skye ba yang lus ngag yid gsum pa skye/ 'bras bu'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i dngos grub kyang de gsum nyid 'gyur ba'i phyir/ rten nam gzhi yin gsungs/ gdams ngag gi gzhi dgod pa bcu gnyis te/ gdams ngag gi rten bca' ba lus ngag yid gsum/ de shes par byed pa'i dus gsum/ 'jal bar byed pa'i bsam pa gsum gtan la 'bebs par byed pa'i tshad ma gsum mo// de la rten bca' ba lus ngag yid gsum la/ lus rags pa dbang rten khog pa dang bcas pa/ phra ba rtsa gsum/ ngag rags pa smra ba dang rgod pa la sogs pa'i tha snyad/

phra ba (99)rlung ldang 'jug rlung phyir ldang ba oṃ nang du gnas pa āḥ'i ngo bor gnas pas gnas pa gsum dang*/ yig 'bru gsum// sems la rten dang brten pa gnyis las/ rten khams dgu rtsa thams cad gnas pa'i dwangs ma byang chub sems kyi thig le dwangs pa'i bdud rtsi/ brten pa rang rig pa'i ye shes gsal ba'o// de yang*/ lus dang ngag dang yid dang gsum/ gcig la lus ngag gi rang bzhin sems la / ba rten pa sems kyi gnas skabs lus ngag la brten te/ yang ji srid lus sems ma bral gyi bar du ngo bo gcig yin par bzhed de/ gcig brten gcig gi ngang*/ yin pas/ sems gcig pu gtan la phabs pas lus ngag gnyis po shugs la phebs thams cad sems myong rig gcig tu rigs gcig pa dang*/ de las ma rtogs pa'i chos med pas par 'gyur la/ sems gtan la dbab na ldog pa'i cha nas/ bsam gyis mi khyab rnam pa lnga ste/ 1mtshan nyid rnam rtog bye brag gi mi 'dra ba'i/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa ma 'dres pa yongs su rdzogs/ ngo bo nyid la rtogs lugs mi 'dra ba'i sgo nas/ phyi rol pa'i dang sangs rgyas pa'i lam dang*/ grub mtha' mi 'dra ba sna tshogs su snang ba'o// yon 2tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dpe yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'am nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bu gcig la 'char lugs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs su snang ba nus pa'i mthu3 ngo bo gcig pu la dngos grub thams cad thabs kyi rkyen 'phrad pas 'byung bas na / bsam gyis mi khyab pa ma pa cings ma bcings pa ni sems dge bskyed pa'i nus pa ngo bo nyid kyi gnas ma grol ba dpe sna ma'i me tog dang til la shing sogs kyi rkyen dang ma 'phrad na mi 'byung la 'phrad na 'byung bas kyang thabs kyi rkyen dang ma 'phrad na mi 'byung bas na ma grol ba'o gsungs mar khu lta bu/ de gsum ni sems gcig la rgyu dang 'bras bu thams cad du snang ba de yang bsam gyis mi lang bas na bsam mi khyab ste thabs so// rang (100)bzhin bsam mi khyab

gsum pos de dag don dam par rgyu dang rang gi ngo bo dang 'bras bu gsum gyis stong pas pa dpe nam mkha' lta bu de ni bsam pas rgyu dang 'bras bu la sogs pa gang ltar yang mi rnyed pas bsam mi khyab ste shes rab bo// ngo bo nyid chos gcig la 'gal ba lta bu'i chos gnyis mi 'gal bar gnas pas bsam1 gyis mi khyab pa ma bral mi ldan pa brtags na mi rnyed pa/ de ni bsam du mi 'dod pas bsam gyis mi khyab pa ste zung 'jug yod med gnyis 'dres pa lta bu'ang ma yin/ gcig gnyis su bgos pa lta bu'ang ma yin// phyogs gcig yod la phyogs gcig med pa lta bu'ang ma yin/ gnyis gcig tu bsdoms pa lta bu'ang ma yin te/ mdor na thabs kyis bsam pas btsal na hril gyi yod la/ shes rab gyi bsam pas btsal na hril gyi med par 'dug la mdor na gnyis su bu ram 'dod pa tsam la gnyis med du zung 'jug ces bya ste/ shes brjod thams cad kyi yul las 'das pa'o gsungs/ de nyid/ de bzhin nyid sogs sngar ltar ming 'dogs so// bsam mi khyab bo// de shes par byed pa'i dus 2gsum ni// gyur gnas pa sems kyis zin te zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi ro gang yar nyams su myong ba'i du na/ sems can gyi dus su rnam rtog bsam mi khyab/ lam sgom pa'i rnal 'byor gyi thog mar dbang gsum pa'i mtshon byid dam nam mkha' la sems bzung ba'i gdams pa la sogs pas sems zin pa yan chod/ ting nge 'dzin bsam mi khyab/ 'bras bu mthar thug pa'i bsam mi khyab lnga mngon tu 'gyur tsam na/ dus su ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab bo// de yang rgyu dus na lus rtsa rlung la sogs sdug bsngal/ ngag las kyi rlung sems rnam rtog 'du 'phro/ lus ngag yid gsum ka rnam rtog gis bsdus/ lam dus rtsi 'gyur rtsi grub pa lta bu/ na gsum ka ting nge 'dzin gyis bsdus lus ldang ba yang ba dang*/ drod dang*/ bde ba sogs (101) ngag smra ba dang rgod pa sogs/

sems thabs kyi ting nge 'dzin/ shes rab kyi ting nge 'dzin/ zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin/ 'bras bu'i dus na ye shes kyis bsdus lus 'ja' tshon ltar snang ba dang gdul bya'i bsam ngor sku du mar snang*/ gsung yang du mar ston pa sems kyi shes bya ji snyed pa dang*/ ji lta ba dang*/ thams cad skad cig gis mkhyen pas na gsum/ pa'o// 'jal bar byed pa'i bsam pa gsum ni// thabs 'jig rten thams cad kun rdzob kyi bden pa myong tshod kyi shes pa la dmigs pa'i bsam pas btsal na thams cad mtshan nyid yon tan nus mthu/ du snang zhing yod/ shes rab don dam pa'i bden pa chos kyi dbyings stong pa nyid la dmigs pa'i dpyod par byed pa'i shes pa/ bsam pas btsal na thams cad kyis stong zhing med/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo nyid la dmigs pa'i bsam pas btsal na yod dpyad cing brtags na mi rnyed pas/ pa min med pa'ang myong ba mi 'gag /ma rgyu lam 'bras bu/ yin te zung 'jug go /gtan la 'bebs pa'i tshad ma gsum ni/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bka'/ ste sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi/ yang dag pa lung gi tshad ma/ bla ma dang po rta mchog nas rang gi dngos kyi bla ma'i bar du gsungs shing*/ rdo rje slob dpon nyams kyi man ngag tshad ma/ rnal 'byor pa bdag nyid kyi nyams myong rjes su dran thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug gsum gyi mnyam par bzhag par skyes nas rjes la de gsum dran pas chos nyid la yid ches pa'o/ pa'i tshad ma'o/ de ltar gdams ngag gi gzhi dgod pa bcu gnyis so// rgyu dus su lta ba gtan la dbab pa'i tshul bstan zin to// de ltar rgyur gnas pa sems can gyi dus su rtogs pa'i lta ba gtan (102)la phabs rje mkhar chung pa thog mar lta ba bstan nas phyis sems bzung ste lta ba rtogs pas sems zin pas sems zin sla ba'i phyir gsungs/ rje mu gu lung pa thog mar sems ma bzung nas lta ba bstan kyang mi go bas/

dang po sems bzung la lta ba phyis bstan gsungs pas ma rnal 'byor pa la dug rnam pa gnyis la/ rig pa'i dug ngo bo nyid ma rtogs pas dngos por zhen pa/ dang bral bar byas nas/ gnyis pa rnam par rtog pa rtsol pa'i dug tha mal rnam rtog gi rgyun chags/ dang bral ba'i phyir lam dus na ting nge 'dzin bskyed cing sbyar ba don bdun tu shes par bya ste/ thog mar sems bzung 1/ bar du de kho na nyid la blo bzhag2 /spyod lam thams cad du goms par bya3/ bsam gtan gyi gegs bying ba dang rgod pa bsal4/ bogs 'byin rnam pa brgyad kyis bogs dbyung 5/ sems nyams kyi drod rtogs dang sbyar6/ mthar phyag rgya ga nas gsum bsrung ba byas te/ la 7brten te spyod pas 'bras bu dang mtshams sbyar ba'o// de la bla mas dang por srog rtsol gyi bsam gtan btsal nas 'di la thog mar slob tu 'jug / dang po sems bzung ba ni/ lus gnad thog mar sems 'dzin la gcig pur la dbab/ ngag gnad la dbab dbugs len gsum drag tu bus la btang*/ sems gnad la dbab cung zhig rang so bzung*/ byang chub bdag gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par byas la sems can thams cad kyi don bya'o snyam du/ kyi sems bsgom/ bla ma bsgom/ spyi bor gus 'dud drag po byas la thim par bsam/ lhag pa'i nga rgyal bsgoms te ngag tu hūm̐ brjod cing sems la hūm̐ dran pa/ bsam gtan drug po bir wa pa dang mthun/ gyi yan lag rnams tshang bar byas la/ phyi rol tu dpe'i tshul tu nam mkha' la bslab ste/ gnyis med nam mkha' sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin 'byung bas so// de'ang thung du de bas na slob dpon nyid kyis don dam pa spros pa dang bral bas bstan (103) du med na/ gzhan nas rtogs pa'i thabs med/ dpe tsam gyis bya ste/ rtogs pa nam mkhar sbyor ba ni// gang gi spros pa'ang smra bar bya// bstan bcos rim pa tshig gis ni// rnam pa'i cha las bshad par bya/ zhes gsungs so//

bslab pa'o// de dag re re la'ang tshar bcad pa'i tshul du bslab pa dang*/ phan gdags pa'i tshul du bslab pa gnyis gnyis su bslab pa'o// de la thung ngu bslab pa ni/ sna rtse nas sor bzhi tshun chad kyi nam mkha' rang gi shes pa yod par dmigs pa ni/ lus sems gnyis ka grim par byas la bsgom/ tshar bcad pa'i tshul du bslab pa'o// de nas lus sems gnyis ka klong par bsgom/ phan gdags pa'i tshul du bslab pa'o// yang sor brgyad tshun chad kyi nam mkhar yang tshul de nyid kyis bslab/ yang sor bcu drug nas 'dom gang tshun chad kyi nam mkhar yang tshul de nyid kyis bslab/ sems gnas pa'i thabs kyi ting nge 'dzin shes rab kyi ting nge 'dzin de gnyis ni bsgom pa/ skyon can zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin skyon med do// nyams ci byung yang de bzhin tu bskyang*/ phal cher rang bzhin stong nyams su skye'o// de nas bogs dbyung ba'i phyir ring du bslab pa ni/ bsam kha shar phyogs su bltas la gtan gyi sngon 'gro'i yan lag tshang bar byas te/ rang rig pa sems nyid shar phyogs su'ang mos do la sogs pa nas bzung ste/ ji srid nam mkha'i mthar thug gi bar du rtog tu btang*/ de yang phan gdags pa dang tshar bcad pa'i tshul gyis bslab pas mtha' 'og ma gnyis dang mi 'dra bar bde stong du/ bral gyi nyams/ shugs chad phan chod mi 'gro bar stan gcig la chags 'dug pa/ chad kyi nyams/ gzi chag gi nyams/ phar btang yang tshur ldog pa/ gsum gang skye yang de bzhin (104)du bskyang ngo*// de bzhin yang bogs dbyung ba'i phyir lho la sogs pa'i steng 'og gnyis yin/ phyogs thams cad du bslab bo// de ltar bslabs pas nyams gsum skye la/ de'i mtha' bral gyi nyams la brten nas/ de nam mkha' mtha' dang bral ba/ stong pa/ gang du'ang ma grub pas/ khyab pa/ shes pa dang shes bya thams cad la/ rtag pa'i gang gis kyang mi 'jig pa snyam byed pa'i/ nyams te chos bzhi ldan tu skye bar 'gyur te de bzhin tu bskyang ngo*/

ring du bslab pa'o// des ni thog mar sems bzung ba'o// bar du de kho na nyid la blo bzhag pa ni/ don nang du rang gi sems nyid la sbyar nas tshul gsum du bslab pas rnam par rtog pa rtsol ba'i dug la 'ching byed bzhi las dang po gsum las grol bar byed do// de la tshul gsum ni/ sgo nga rgya bcag ngang ba'i sgo nga khru gang nang na lus thams cad rdzogs nas yod kyang*/ phyi'i rgya ma bcag na 'gro mi shes pa la/ bcag na shes pa ltar ro/ pa'i tshul du ming skye med bsam mi khyab la sbyar ba/ brgya dbral ba'i bab pa de nyid na yod kyang*/ phyi'i rgya ma bral na mi 'gro dbral na 'gro/ tshul du don skye med bsam mi khyab la sbyar ba/ kha chu bsal srin bu rang gi kha chus bstum nas mi mngon pa de bsal ma thag rjen gcod kyis mngon pa lta bu'o// ba'i tshul du ting nge 'dzin nyid kyang skye med bsam mi khyab la sbyar ba'o// de la dang po ming ni dngos po ma grub pa la dngos por mngon par zhen pas chags sdang sogs skye bas/ gi 'ching pa las grol bar bya ba'i phyir// ming skye med bsam mi khyab la sbyar ba ni/ rnal 'byor pa bsam gtan gyi yan lag 'ching bar byas la/ rang nyid kyi ming la sogs pa ming gang yang rung ba la/ ma skyes de ltar ming la bstod kyang phan 'dogs pa med la/ skyon brjod kyang gnod (105)pa med pas/ dang po ming dang bcas nas skye ba ma yin te/ blo bur du btags pa yin pas/ skye med nam mkha' bzhin// skyes pa skye med gang du'ang ma 'gags te/ nam mkha' rang la thim par 'gyur bas/ nam mkha' bzhin 'gags pa skye med nam mkha' bzhin// zhes bslabs pas sprin sogs nam mkha' la thim pa bzhin/ ming du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa sems nyid la thim zhing*/ gsal la mi 'gag pa'i nyams skye ste/ de nyid la rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum dang po mtshan ma med pa/ gnyis pa stong pa nyid/ gsum pa smon pa med pa/

gyi ming thob gsung*/ de lta bu'ang gzhung las/ gnyis su med pa ming tsam ste// de yang ming ni yod mi 'gyur// gnyis med ming du bzung ba la// de la rnal 'byor pas bzod mdzod/ ces 'byung ba dang*/ rgyal ba'i yum las/ rab 'byor gzugs ni btags pa tsam mo// btags pa tsam gang yin pa de yang chos nyid de/ zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs so// gnyis pa don gyi 'ching ba las chags sdang la sogs pa skye med yin pa la dngos por bzung bas bcings/ grol bar bya ba'i phyir/ don skye med bsam mi khyab pa la sbyar ba ni/ rang rig nyon mongs pa'i sems nyid 'di la rgyu ba gang rags brtags la/ rgyu ba rags pa zhe sdang lta bu gcig gi dbang du bas nas thog ma'i skye ba'i rgyu dang*/ da ltar gnas pa'i ngo bo dang*/ mthar 'gags pa'i 'bras bu gsum yang skye med bsam mi khyab pa nam mkha' lta bur sbyar zhing brtag /yang lus ngag yid gsum gang la skyes pa gnas gang yin brtag /rigs dang gang yin brtag /rang gi ngo bo gsum la kha dog dang dbyibs la sogs pa gang du grub brtag / brtags te skye med du bsgom/ (106)de ltar brtag pas mi rnyed pa

bsgoms pas zhe sdang du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog sems nyid la thim zhing*/ zhe sdang gi gsal ba mi bgags pa'i nyams skye'o/ de'ang gzhung las/ gnyis po dag gi spyod pa yis// gnyis med ye shes 'bar bar 'gyur/ zhes 'byung ngo*// gsum pa bsgom bya'i yul dang*/ sgom byed kyi shes pa dang*/ sgom pa po gsum dngos po las ma grub pa la der 'dzin pa/ 'ching bar byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi 'ching ba las grol bar bya ba'i phyir ting nge 'dzin nyid kyang skye med bsam mi khyab la sbyar ba ni/ nang du yid 'dzin med du bzhag pa dang*/ phyi rol tu shes pa lhug par bzhag pa gnyis so// dang po ni/ lus sems yang par bya/ de nas shes pa kha nang du blta bya tsam dran par bya/ des bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin skye// gal te phyir 'phro na yang sngar bzhin tu dran par bya/ gnyis pa ni/ yul gang la'ang 'dzin pa med par dbang po'i sgo lhug par bzhag /de ltar bsgom bya'i yul la sgom byed kyi shes pa gcig gis ched du gtad nas mi bsgom ste/ gang ltar yang mi bsgom pa'i tshul gyis bsgoms pas/ bsgom pa'i yul la sogs pa zhen pa dang bral nas ting nge 'dzin bde stong mchog tu skye bar 'gyur ro// de'ang gzhung las/ tshor dang tshor po mtshon bya bral// rigs po dang rig bya spang*/ de man chad la thabs kyi ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa gang skyed bzhin tu skyong ngo*/ zhes 'byung ba'o// de dag mnyam gzhag la chags sdang la sogs pa mi skye yang*/ rkyen dang 'phrad tsam na skye'o/ brtan pa'i yan lag tu rkyen gyi 'ching ba las grol bar bya ba'i phyir spyod lam thams cad du goms par bya ba ni/ dang po rje mu gu lung pa dang por bslab par bzhed/ rje mkhar chung pa sgra nas bslag (107) rna zin che bar bzhed/ rje dgon pa'i gang zag gi rigs mi gcig pas nyams dang sbyar gsungs skad/ gzugs lta bu bslab pa'i dbang du byas nas/ mig la nyi ma'i 'od dang*/

rlung gi ser bu mi 'ong bar byas te/ mdun tu me tog la sogs pa'i dngos po gcig nye ring ran par bzhag la/ de dag la rten mi 'gyur de las gzhan las mi blta/ ba'i yan lag /lus mi g.yo ba'i yan lag /mig mi 'dzum pa'i yan lag /yid 'dzin pa gang la ched du gtad sa med par/ med pa'i yan lag ste/ yan lag bzhi ldan tu byas nas bslabs pas/ yul de la mi dmigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye/ de nas nyi ma gnyis la sogs pa la / rten mthar rgyang grags dang*/ dpag tshad la sogs par bslab/ de thag je ring je ring bsrings la bslab ste/ gzugs las ye shes ngos bzung ba'o// de bzhin tu sgra la sogs pa yang yan lag bzhi ldan tu byas nas bslab ste/ de ltar yul las ye shes ngos bzung ba'i gdams ngag gis bsgoms pas/ thog mar sems nyams chung ngu la sogs pa yul rkyen gyis res gnod res phan res bde zhing skye ste snang ba lha mor 'char ba'i dus so/ 'bring po la phan gnod med pa'i dus/ sems nyams chen po la me 'bar ba la shing bsnan pa bzhin du yul rkyen gyi rtog pa ye shes kyi grogs byed de/ yul rkyen rab gzugs sdug pa dang tha mal pa gsum/ bzhin tu sgra la sogs pa la'ang gsum gsum/ 'bring gsum dang 'phrad ma thag tu/ nang du de kho na nyid kyi rtogs pa'i ye shes mchog tu 'gyur ro// de ni snang bar ting nge 'dzin skye bas/ phan 'dogs pa'i dus/ snang ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen du 'char ba'i dus/ bdag gi dngos (108)po la sogs gcig nyid du mar tu ma las snang ba'i dngos po la sogs gcig tu phyi nang gnyis 'dres pa'i dus/ dug lnga sman tu tha mal pa chags sdang skye ba des dzo ki la rtogs pa skye bas/ de tsam la 'don yon brten kyang nyes par mi 'gyur ba'o// ngo shes pa'i dus so// de'ang gzhung las/ mig gi rnam shes rtogs pa yi// gnyis med ye shes ngo mtshar che/ zhes 'byung ba dang*/ gzugs mchog tha ma 'bring po gang*// gang yang mig gis mthong gyur pa// don dam don gyi rang bzhin gyis// gnyis med dam pa blta bar bya/

zhes bya ba la sogs pa 'byung bas bstan to// de nas bsam gtan gyi gegs bying ba dang rgod pa bsal ba ni/ spyir gsum ste/ ched du byas pa'i bying rgod/ rkyen gyis byung ba'i bying rgod/ shugs kyis byung ba'i bying rgod bsal ba'o// de la ched du byas pa'i bying ba ni/ mal stan la sogs pa bsod nams don du gnyer ba las byung ba'o// ched du byas ba'i rgod pa ni/ kha smras la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i bya ba don tu gnyer ba las byung ba'o// de bsal ba ni/ ngo shes par byas te zhag grangs ci rigs par de dag spangs la nyid kyis rang sel bar 'gyur ro// rkyen gyis bying ba ni/ ha cang kha zas bcud ches pa dang*/ chang mang ba dang*/ ngal dub la sogs pa'i rkyen gyis bying ba'o// rkyen gyis rgod pa ni/ nyin mo skye bo rgyun lugs kyis ma dben pa dang*/ mtshan mo sgra'i klag 'di dag la brtan po gzhan mi dgos te/ cor gyis ma dben pa la sogs pas rgod pa'o// de dag las bsal ba yang*/ rkyen de dag zhag grangs ci rigs pa spangs pa nyid kyis rang sel lo/ rang shugs kyis byung ba dang rgod pa ni/ snga ma gnyis po de dag bsal kyang (109)rang shugs kyis 'byung ba'o/ de yan thun stod la 'byung ngam/ thun smad la 'byung ba rtags la/ thun smad la byung na/ bsam bstan gyi skyon ma yin te/ khams kyi skyon yin pas bskyungs pa nyid kyis rang sel lo/ lan grangs mang du bya gsungs/ thun stod la byung na bsam bstan gyi gegs yin pas de bsal ba ni/ spyir gsum ste/ spyod lam gyis bsal/ kha zas kyis bsal/ sems kyi mthus bsal ba'o// de la spyod lam gyis bying ba bsal ba ni/ stan mtho sar bsdad/ des ma sel na/ sa mtho sar bsdad/ 'di gsum dus gcig tu bstun la bya/ mig ri thang mtshams su blta/ lus sems hur phyung bya'o// rgod pa bsal ba ni/ sa dma' sar bsdad/ cung zad kos kos brang non par bya/ mun pa'i mtshan mar gyur pa la bsdad do// kha zas kyis bying ba bsal ba ni/

gang bsam bstan gyi sngon rol gyi kha zas bcag pa'o// rgod pa bsal ba ni/ bsam bstan la 'jug khar kha zas dang bcas pa'i chang snod che chung ci rigs pa gang btang*/ yul gang yin pa'i phul gang tsam/ gom pa lnga bcur bcag de nas bsgom/ des ma zhi na do btang*/ gom pa brgyar bcag /de yang spyir nad gzhi dang*/ khrag mkhris shas che na nyung du btang*/ bad kan dang rlung shas che na mang du btang ngo*// sbyar/ na tshod/ lang tsho babs pas nyung ngu rgas pa la mang du bya'o// dang sbyar/ nam zla dang sbyar ro/ des nges par bying ba dang rgod pa sel lo// gsum pa sems kyi nus mthus bsal ba ni/ bying ba'i tshe steng du byang chub kyi sems bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo'i 'khor lo la bslab/ slar yang yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i gnas su bslab ste/ de nas thog mar rang gi (110)sems rang gi snying gar na yod/ dran par bya/ de nas tshangs pa'i bu gar/ de nas spyi bo'i steng du sor bzhi/ 'dis lha'i gnas mthong ba la sogs pa 'byung gsungs/ la sogs pa nas mthar steng gi nam mkha'i mthar thug par btang*/ mtha' rtog tu/ de ltar sems bying ba sel nus sam ma nus/ tshod bzung zhing bsgoms la/ steng du/ yun ring na shes pa mi bde zhing*/ snying rlung la sogs par 'gyur bas/ slar mar rim gyis bab la snying gar dran par byas la bzhag go /rgod pa'i tshe na/ 'og tu byang chub kyi sems e chos kyi 'byung gnas su bslab/ slar yang yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po de'i gnas su bslab bo// de ni dang por rang dang stan gyi bar du nam mkha' stong pa gcig byung bar bsam pa tsam gyis kyang sel/ des ma sel na/ gshang lam du chos 'byung dmar seng nge ba cig bsams la/ de'i nang na mar sems kyis blta/ 'jog tsam na slar yang snying gar dran par bya'o// des kyang rgod pa ma zhi na 'phrang du bzung*/ rjes su 'brang*/ yongs su shes pas bsal lo// de la 'phrang du bzung ba ni/

lan cig 'phros/ lan gnyis 'phros zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshul gyis rgod pa'i grangs bzung bas 'phral du sel/ rjes su 'brang pa ni/ yul gang la 'phros pa'i yul de la ched du gtad cing dmigs/ des kyang myur du sel/ yongs su shes pa/ sems su shes pa tsam/ ni rgod nas 'dug bya bar shes pa tsam gyis sel gsungs/ de dag gis kyang ma zhi na/ mnan sbyor/ dpyang thag /'phrang gzhur zhes bya bas kyang sel lo// de la mnan sbyor ni/ rang gi spyi bor shing bu lci yang ran pa gcig gis mnan te bsgom/ des 'phral du sel/ dpyang thag ni/ sa gzhi bstar zhing 'thas par byas la/ (111)steng du thag pa gsum gyis shing stegs gcig btags te/ de'i steng du rang gi rkang pa 'og tu brkyang nas 'dug pas/ rkang pa'i brang pas/ shing bu ril po non par bya/ gcig gi steng du/ lag pa thag pa bstung nas mdun phyogs su 'gro/ bsrings nas rgyab phyogs su 'gro/ gnyis mdun gyi dpyang thag la 'ju ba'i sbyor ba bya ba'i man ngag go /'phrang gzhur ni/ g.yas g.yon gang rung gcig tu shing khru ba gcig gam/ tho gcig btsugs la/ rdo la sogs pa dkar po gcig bzhag /de'i steng du nag po gcig bzhag la/ de dag snyug ma la sogs pas gzhur te/ mig mi 'dzum par byas la blta/ des kyang 'phral du sel gsungs/ bsam gtan gyi gegs bying rgod bsal ba'o// de nas bogs 'byin rnam pa brgyad kyis bogs dbyung ba ni/ sgrim klod gnyis res 'jog /dbri bskyed gnyis res 'jog ste bzhi/ kha zas res 'jog /spyod lam bag yang*/ sems kyi gnad sna tshogs su 'pho ba/ yul sna tshogs kyi bdud rtsi bsten pa ste/ rnam pa brgyad kyis sems nyams dang sbyar te bogs dbyung ngo*// dang po la bzhi/ lus sems gnyis ka sgrim pa dang thun dbri ba sbyar / klod pa dang bskyed pa la sbyar la/ dang por thun res 'jog thun dang po tho rangs sgrims te thung du bya ba la sogs pa bya/

tu bya/ de nas nyi ma nyi ma dang po sgrim ste thung du sogs res 'jog tu bya/ kha zas thun dang po la kha zas mi za bar sgom pa la sogs pa go sla'o// res 'jog kyang thun dang nyi ma gnyis ka la chang la sogs pa res 'jog tu bya'o// spyod lam bag yang gi bdud rtsi bsten pa go la/ sems kyi gnad sna tshogs su 'pho ba ni/ mdo sde dang rgyud sde la sogs pa rnams las (112)bsgom byar gsungs pa thams cad la rim gyis bsgom pas bogs dbyung bar 'gyur ba'o// yul sna tshogs kyi bdud rtsi bsten pa ni/ gzugs sdug pa rnams la longs spyod pas rgyud tshims par 'gyur la/ de'i stobs kyis rtogs pa bogs dbyung bar 'gyur ro// de ltar bogs 'byin brgyad do// de lta bu'i gar spyin kyi phung po la lag pas reg pa bzhin dmigs pa btang du mi 'dod pa'o// tshul gyis bsgom pas sems nyams kyi drod rtags6 dbyung ba ni thog mar sems gnas/ don gyi de kho na nyid la nges shes skye/ cung zad le lo che/ bya ba gang la'ang 'jug snying mi 'dod/ brjed ngas/ bya ba thams cad la drug 'phrad tsam byed/ skabs skabs su dran pa gsal po khyad par can 'byung*/ kha zas la 'dod pa chung*/ gnyid rim gyis spang bar nus/ nyon mongs blo bur ba drag po zlog /chos brgyad kyi rnam par rtog pa'i blo rags rim zlog /rmi lam mngon shes dang 'dra ba'i gsal po 'byung*/ phyi dang nang gi srin bu rim rim gyis spong nus/ de tsam na ngan song du mi skye ba'i gding thob bo// mthar spyod pas 'bras bu dang mtshams sbyar ba ni shin tu spros pa/ 'di'i gong na bgrod par bya ba'i lam gzhan med pas 'di zab par bzhed gsungs/ med pa'i spyod pa dbang bzhi pa'i lam yin te/ de yang gong du bstan pa'i tshul ltar bsgom pa'i mthar/ sprul pa'i sku zhing las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro mas/ phyag rgya bu mo padma can he badzra las/ gnang ba rnyed gyur sngags pa la// rnal 'byor ma yis bstan par bya// phyag rgya che ge mo khyer la// sems can don gyis rdo rje 'dzin/

ces pa'o// la sogs pa lung bstan pa byed de/ slob dpon 'di'i bzhed (113)pas lha'i bu mo la sogs pa la yang 'grogs pa'i nus pa yod par bzhed pas/ de lta bu'i lung bstan pa'i dang po nas gom pa'i bu mo grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor ma la'ang brten du 'dod na'ang*/ 'dir lung bstan pa'i bu mo gtso che bar bzhed gsungs/ bu mo la sogs pa la brten nas mchog gi dngos grub mngon tu byed pa'i tshe/ bdag dang phyag rgya gnyis por/ rnam snang la sogs/ bdag mi bskyod pa'i rnal 'byor yin na/ rgyud yongs su dag pa'i phyag rgya de ma mā kir bskyed pa la sogs so sor sbyar/ pa lha gang la me tog phog pa'i lha'i 'du shes su bya/ mkha' dang gsang ba byin gyis brlabs te sngags kyi 'du shes su bya/ thabs shes snyoms par zhugs pa las mchog gi dngos grub mngon tu bya snyam pas chos kyi 'du shes byas te/ de ltar 'du shes gsum dang ldan pas thabs shes rab snyoms par zhugs pa las/ gnyis ka'i sgo dgu dang bral ba'i rtsal sogs pa/ rtsa gnas thams cad nas byang chub kyi sems khams dgu'i dwangs ma rnams re zhig spyi bor ham̐ gi gnas su 'du/ de nas rtsa gsum 'dzom pa'i gnas/ so so'i rtsa gsum nas dbang gi gnas su 'du ba'i bar du yas bab babs kyi khams dwangs ma thig le zla bas dbang du byas/ shes rab kyi thams cad rakta nyi mas dbang du byas te/ 'dus nas/ pa'i dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong*/ de nas gnas mchog gi ze bar/ thig le nyi zla gzas zin pa'i dus su/ khams dwangs ma de rgya mtsho'i nang gi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ram nyi ma 'char ka'i 'od ltar kha dog sna tshogs pa mngon tu byed la/ de'i tshe 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad thig le gcig po de'i nang du lag mthil gyi ri mo bltad bzhin/ mthong bar 'gyur/ de nyid las bcu gnyis pa zhes kyang ming thob bo// rgyu'i (114)skad cig ma zag bcas kyi bde ba zhes kyang bya'o// de nas thabs shes gnyis so sor rgyud dag par bya ba ni thabs kyis 'dren pa'i bye brag rigs gsum gyis g.yas nas drangs/

g.yon nas drangs/ dbus ma nas drangs/ thabs rgyad dag pa/ de bzhin tu shes rab kyis/ shes rab kyi rgyud dag pa/ kyang drangs/ de'i mthar khams gnyis ka'i rgyud dag pa/ dgu'i dwangs mar gyur pa de dal bar rgyu ba'i rlung shin tu 'byongs par gyur pa yis gnyis ka'i rtsa dbu ma nas/ yar gyen la spyi bo'i ham̐ gi gnas su thim/ 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas/ par gyur la/ de'i dus su mas brtan pa'i dga' ba bzhi'i nyams myong skye la/ de'i mthar rlung sems thams cad dbu mar thim pas rgyud gnyis dus gnyis gcig tu grol te/ 'bras bu sa bcu gsum pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ye shes mngon tu byed par 'gyur ro// de'ang gzhung las/ rlung 'byongs nas/ dal par rgyu ba'i rig pa yi// bye brag gsum du 'dren par byed// srol gnyis ka'i dbu ma/

gong rdo rje'i sbu gu ru/ nges par 'dren pa/ gong na med pa/ lam gyis mchog /dwangs ma'i bdud rtsis shin tu gang*// gsum nas gnyis ka cha ེ/ byung zhing gsum so so'i rtsa gsum/ dang 'dres/ phan tshun tu/ yon tan rdzogs shing mngon shes 'char/ 'khor 'das thig le'i nang du mthong*/ zhes byung gong 'dren na/ ba la sogs pa'i don te/ lam dus su ting nge 'dzin bskyed cing sbyangs pa'i tshul bstan zin to// gsum pa 'bras bu ni slob dpon 'dis sku gsum yan lag bdun ldan tu bzhed de/ de'ang chos kyi sku la rang bzhin med pa'i yan lag gcig ni/ dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa yin la (115)gzhung las/ gnyis med rgya mtsho dam pa nyid/ zhes bya ba dang*/ ye shes rgya mtsho dam pa nyid/ ces bya bas bstan to// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yan lag gsum gyis bsdus te/ zag med kyi bde bas tshims pa khyad par can dang ldan pas bde chen gyi yan lag ste/ de yang*/ bde ba'i dbang phyug lta bur gzhan/ zhes bya ba dang*/ kun tu 'dod chags chags chen las/ zhes pas bstan to// rang gi lam bskyed rdzogs la mnyam rjes gnyis 'dod yon ma spangs pas 'bras bu 'dod yon gyi snang ba mi 'gags pa/ ye shes kyi snang bar gyur pa'i yum dang bcas pa'i kha sbyor gyi yan lag /mtshan dpe 'bar bas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i yan lag go /sprul pa'i sku yang yan lag gsum ldan te/ rgyu'i yan lag snying rje nges par gang ba/ sems can su ni 'dul ba'i dus la bab/ su ni ma bab ces pa'i tshul gyis rtag tu gzigs pa/ 'bras bu yan lag las dgag phyogs kyi don bya rgyu'i sems can rgyun mi 'chad pas don mi byed pa mi srid pa/ yan lag 'gog pa med pa dang*/ sgrub phyogs kyi yan lag / 'dul byed rgyun mi chad pas don byed pa kho na 'o gsungs/ rgyun mi 'chad pa'o// de'ang gzhung las/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad kyi// mtha' yas mthar thug thams cad du// chos kyi 'khor lo skor bso// zhes bya ba la sogs pas bstan to// 'bras bu ye shes kyi dbang du byas pa bstan zin to// de ltar tshig nye bar bsdu ba 'di dag gis bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnam pa la brten te lam yongs su rdzogs pa'i gdams ngag go

/sa māsti mi thi/ ༈ bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnam pa lnga las/ yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skabs su/ chos nyid rang ngo bo nyid/ lam grub mtha' la sogs pa sna tshogs su snang yang*/ gi ngo bo las mi g.yo bar thams cad la tha dad par bstan pa/ theg (116)pa chen po'i mdo las/ snang byed mkha' las ma g.yos kyang*// mthun snang ri bo'i phag tu 'gyur// rlung gi shing rtas drangs shing spyod// nges par rang re'i ri'i rtse mo kho na nas 'char bas/ rtogs kyang de ltar min/ rang bzhin sems ngo bo nyid/ dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// rnam rtog ri bo'i phag tu 'gyur// rtog pa rang rang gi gzhung lugs kyis bskyed pa'i/ rlung gis drangs shing bskyed// nges par rang rang gi thub mtha' bden pa/ rtogs kyang de ltar min// zhes gsungs so// lta ba ngo bo nyid kyi skabs su med pa rnam pa drug tu gnas te/ rgyu yis rgyu dngos po'i chos min ma sems ma grub pas/ bskyed pa med/ rkyen gyis 'jig pa med/ nges 'gre/ dpes mtshon du med/ gnyen pos sems la cha shas med pas/ spang blang med/ lam ngo bo nyid sbyangs pas bzang du mi 'gro bas/ gyis sbyang du med/ 'bras bu 'khor 'das kyi chos la khyad par med pa'o// la re dogs med do// rnal 'byor pa'i lam nyams su len pa'i dus zhen nam sgro btags na/ na yod pa rnam pa drug gis bying rgod kyi rkyen gyis 'jig /gzugs brnyan sogs kyis mtshon/ rtog pa spangs shing mi rtog pa skye bogs 'byin gyis gong nas gong du sbyang du rung*/ rtun pa can tshe gcig gis 'bras bu thob/ 'bring bar dor/ tha ma skye ba bdun nam bcu drug tshun chad kyis thob tu yod do// nyams su len dgos te/ rgyu yis bskyed pa yod ces nyams myong dbang gsum pa sogs kyis/ bya ba la sogs bya'o gzhan yang de bzhin nyid dus gsum du mi 'gyur bas/ dngos po'i gnas lugs ma bcos pa'i don gyi na/

sngon tu grub pa'i chos nyid ye nas gnas pas na/ rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'khor 'das thams (117) cad la bzang ngan med par khyab pa'i don gyis na/ slob dpon sems kyi rgyal po'o/ 'khor 'das kyi 'bras bu byed pa yin pas na/ yang de rtogs bya'i ma de bzhin nyid rtogs pa la sogs pa la rim gyis sbyar/ ye shes/ rtogs pa'i lta ba/ so so rang rang gi rig pa/ chos nyid tshul bzhin yid la byed pa/ rnal 'byor nga 'di nas lam sna zin pas gsungs/ pa'i sa dang po'o/ de dag thams cad ming gi rnam grangs so/ shubham̐// ༈ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// slob dpon 'di'i lugs kyi log gnon rnam pa lnga ste/ 'khor lo ltar bskor ba/ dru gu ltar dril ba/ bu ga mang po'i sbyor ba/ steng 'og gi 'khor lo med pa la bslab pa/ rab tu dma' ba'i sbyor ba la bslab pa'o// dang po ni/ lus khengs pa snyam byed cing na ba la sogs pa byung na/ lte ba'i gnas su 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad ser po gcig bsams la/ 'khor lo de dang po g.yas su 'khor bar bsgom/ des ma bde na g.yon tu 'khor bar bsgom/ de ltar 'khor bar je che je cher song bas lus kyang je cher song bar bsgom/ des shin tu cher song bar snyam byed na/ 'khor lo blos btang la/ lus nang stong pa de nam mkha' la dengs shing yas te med par bsam/ des 'phral tu skyon las grol lo/ gnyis pa ni/ snying ga la sogs pa'i lus khol bur dmigs kyis na ba byung na/ gang nas der bu ga gcig sang gis byung bar bsams la/ de nas dbugs phyir drag tu btang zhing*/ sems kyis rlung kha dog sngon po/ sbom phra rta rnga tshad tsam gcig byung nas phyi rol tu khru gang (118)pa hril li le 'dril bar bsam/ de nas cung zhig dmigs pa de blos dor/ de nas yang bu ga de cher song nas rlung yang sngar bas sbom du song bar dmigs te/ skud pa'i tshad tsam nas thag pa'i tshad tsam gyi bar du song bar dmigs pa sngar bzhin tu dril bar bsam/

des 'phral tu skyon las grol lo// gsum pa ni/ lus thams cad khyab par na na/ lus thams cad la tshags sa'i mig bzhin tu bu ga mang po byung ste/ de dag thams cad nas phyir rlung sngo bun bun 'gro bar bsams shing dbugs phyir drag tu bus la btang*/ skyon 'phral tu sel/ khams la cung zhig gnod gsungs// bzhi pa ni/ lus kyi stod du na zhing mi bde na/ mgrin pa yan chad han dang du stong par bsams la/ de nas yar rlung sngo bun bun 'gro bar bsam zhing dbugs phyir drag tu btang*/ lus kyi smad du na zhing mi bde na smad nyid han dang stong par bsams la/ de nas mar rlung thur la des gal te thur bu 'gyu na 'og rlung drag tu bskum pas chad gsungs/ sngo bun bun 'gro bar bsgom/ de dag gis 'phral tu skyon las grol lo// lnga pa ni/ mchod rgyug la sogs pa du ma byung na/ rang gi 'dug sa'i 'og de dong lta bu shin tu dma' bar bsams te/ de nas mar rang gi lus bying bar bsam/ des mi sel mi srid gsungs/ log gnon rnam pa lnga'i man ngag sa māsti mi thi/ sarba maṅga laṃ/
